does: Returns the id of the Dialog stream of one player, creating the stream when there is none.

evidence.says: the return chain of the CreateStream hit at +0x309FD9E on the first dialogue check passes +0x309F5E9; read in decomp code: looks up a stream of type 1 (Dialog) with the player's id at +0x4C, else creates one
The write of the last stream id over the first dialogue check returns through +0x309F5E9 inside this function
It looks for the stream of type 1 with the player's id and makes one when there is none
